Description.English: Adds 12 Gracchus specialists, +30t storage for the Granary and all warehouse tiers, and two auto-granted chests. Scipio boosts all residences, Gaius, Lucius, and Agrippa supply each region's workforces, Marcellus upgrades army recruitment and strength, and Latinus, Britannicus, and Aegyptius give an island every fertility of their region.
